svg.title: How it works. FundBot answers factual questions about 4 Mirae Asset schemes and general mutual fund concepts; refuses investment advice, personal identifiers and schemes from other fund houses; declines anything retrieval is not confident about, saying so rather than guessing; and cites the source URL and the date it was last read on every answer. A question goes through three stages. One, guardrails (fundbot/guards.py): personal data, then scope, then advice; a blocked question never reaches the knowledge base or the model. Two, retrieval (fundbot/retrieval.py): hybrid BM25F and TF IDF over 47 curated documents; below a confidence of 0.06 FundBot says it does not know. Three, generation (fundbot/llm.py): DeepSeek through OpenRouter rephrases the retrieved passage; it is optional, and any failure falls back to the passage verbatim. The browser then renders the answer with its source link. Answers can get less conversational; they never get less correct.

div.p: Factual questions on 4 Mirae Asset schemes and general fund concepts.
Investment advice, personal identifiers, other fund houses.
Anything retrieval is unsure of. It says so instead of guessing.
Every answer carries its source URL and the date it was read.
A blocked question never reaches the knowledge base or the model.
Hybrid scoring over 47 curated documents, with fund affinity.
Via OpenRouter, optional. Rewrites the passage, adds no numbers.

div.div: refusedPolite refusal, pointer to a SEBI registered adviser or AMFI
below 0.06"I don't know" instead of a guess
key missing or timeoutRetrieved passage returned verbatim

div.p: If the key is missing, the quota is exhausted or the request times out, FundBot falls back to the retrieved text. The app works with no LLM at all.
